_meta.purpose: Feature-to-surface map. Each workflow declares the surfaces required for the feature to be considered complete (schema, migration, helper, route, UI, etc.). Validators evaluate each surface independently and aggregate to PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL / UNVERIFIED.

rule_id_namespaces.C##: UCBA Master Copy 2026 rule (e.g. C15 = Auction Listing Requirements)
rule_id_namespaces.WS-C#: Workstream-C feature track from memory/FOLLOWUP-2026-05-01.md (WS-C1=Inquiry, WS-C2=Offer, WS-C3=Auction, WS-C4=Ethics)

surface_keys.schema: Prisma model definition exists in prisma/schema.prisma
surface_keys.migration: SQL migration file exists in prisma/migrations/
surface_keys.helper: Server-side helper module (lib/...) exists and exports the expected entry points
surface_keys.backend_route: Next.js API route file exists at the declared path
surface_keys.mapper: Trestle/REBNY field mapper exists and references the field
surface_keys.gate: Compliance gate (rls-enforcement, dto, content-restrictions) enforces the rule
surface_keys.dto: Public/portal DTO sanitizer applies the rule
surface_keys.ui_form: CRM form (HTML or React) collects the field from the user
surface_keys.frontend_display: Public-facing display (search, listing detail, portal) renders the field
surface_keys.cron: Scheduled cron job runs the workflow
surface_keys.audit_log: AuditEvent row is written when the action runs
surface_keys.production_check: Live production endpoint or page reflects the workflow
surface_keys.runtime_test: Automated test (jest/integration) proves the side effect
surface_keys.rollout_action: Operational action (script run, env set, etc.) — see operational-actions.json

workflows.name: auction_listing
workflows.title: Auction Listing — UCBA Art. I §15
workflows.notes: Schema (C3a #50) and backend enforcement (C3b #57) shipped. UI form sub-section (C3c) deferred. Workflow status: PARTIAL until ui_form surface lands.

workflows.name: inquiry_capture
workflows.title: Inquiry Capture — UCBA C1 (lead recording)
workflows.notes: All 8 lead-capture endpoints wire createInquiry. Runtime side-effect proof (Phase 3) will confirm rows actually land in DB; until then the workflow is PASS at the static layer and UNVERIFIED at the runtime layer.

workflows.name: offer_transmission
workflows.title: Offer Transmission — UCBA Art. II §18
workflows.notes: Idempotent re-submit + precondition check both implemented. Runtime test must verify transmitted_to_seller_at is actually written.

workflows.name: ethics_training_gate
workflows.title: Ethics Training Auth Gate — UCBA Art. III §6
workflows.notes: All static surfaces in place. Operational action (backfill execution) declared in operational-actions.json — release validator must check postcondition.

workflows.name: listing_display
workflows.title: Public IDX Listing Display — REBNY UCBA Art. III §2 (attribution + gates)
workflows.notes: Core REBNY IDX display path. All 6 distribution gates must be enforced before public render.

workflows.name: search_query
workflows.title: Public Search — IDX-eligible inventory only
workflows.notes: Public search must respect all 6 distribution gates and never expose Owner Opt-Out or Participant Only listings.

workflows.name: mfa_broker_login
workflows.title: Broker MFA — UCBA Art. III §6 + NY SHIELD Act session security
workflows.notes: Broker login is always MFA-gated. SMS via Twilio is optional; email OTP is mandatory.

workflows.name: client_portal_access
workflows.title: Client Portal Access — buyer/seller/landlord/tenant role-based
workflows.notes: Each client portal is role-gated; agent PII must be masked from buyer/tenant view.

workflows.name: idx_sync
workflows.title: IDX Trestle Delta Sync (cron, every 12 min)
workflows.notes: Trestle is the source of truth. Sync runs every 12 minutes via vercel.json cron. Watermark in SyncState model prevents duplicate processing.

workflows.name: data_retention
workflows.title: Data Retention — REBNY §2.05 (closed listings >24h removed) + NY SHIELD Act
workflows.notes: Daily 3am cron flips idx_display_yn=false for terminal listings older than 24h. UCBA-mandated within-24hr removal.

workflows.name: fair_housing_scan
workflows.title: Fair Housing — Federal FHA + NY HRL + NYC Title 8 hard-block enforcement
workflows.notes: Hard-block scanner runs on every listing description + remarks. Penalty = $250+ fine and RLS termination on second offense.
